conflicts.why: Set speed ends at 160 km/h, but 180 km/h shall be settable.
Every gap shall be at least 1.0 s, but 0.8 s shall be selectable.
Takeover request within 2 s versus no later than 4 s.
At most 3.5 m/s² versus up to 5 m/s².
0.3 g is about 2.9 m/s², more than the 2.5 m/s² limit.
5 m/s is 18 km/h, below the 30 km/h activation speed.

decoys.why: Long press and short press are different inputs.
Radar and camera are different sensors with different ranges.

vague.why: reliably in all weather conditions, untestable

texts.ACC-R-010: The driver shall be able to set a target speed between 30 km/h and 160 km/h.
texts.ACC-R-011: The maximum target speed the driver can set shall be 180 km/h.
texts.ACC-R-012: The time gap to the vehicle ahead shall be at least 1.0 s in every gap setting.
texts.ACC-R-013: The shortest selectable time gap setting shall be 0.8 s.
texts.ACC-R-014: A long press on the speed button shall change the set speed in steps of 5 km/h.
texts.ACC-R-015: The system shall react fast to a vehicle cutting in.
texts.ACC-R-016: The system shall keep a sufficient distance to stationary objects.
texts.ACC-R-020: If the system reaches its limits, a takeover request shall be shown to the driver within 2 s.
texts.ACC-R-021: The system shall use the service brake for all decelerations.
texts.ACC-R-022: In ACC mode, the system shall decelerate the vehicle by at most 3.5 m/s².
texts.ACC-R-024: The longitudinal acceleration requested by ACC shall not exceed 2.5 m/s².
texts.ACC-R-026: ACC shall only be active at vehicle speeds above 30 km/h.
texts.ACC-R-027: The radar sensor shall detect vehicles at a distance of at least 150 m.
texts.ACC-R-028: The camera shall detect lane markings at a distance of at least 60 m.
texts.ACC-R-030: To follow a braking vehicle ahead, ACC may request a deceleration of up to 5 m/s².
texts.ACC-R-031: Braking interventions shall feel as smooth as possible.
texts.ACC-R-032: The display shall inform the driver appropriately about the system state.
texts.ACC-R-033: A short press on the speed button shall change the set speed in steps of 1 km/h.
texts.ACC-R-034: The ACC status shall be shown in the instrument cluster.
texts.ACC-R-041: A takeover request shall be issued no later than 4 s after the system has reached its limits.
texts.ACC-R-045: When resuming after a stop, ACC shall accelerate the vehicle with up to 0.3 g.
texts.ACC-R-047: In stop-and-go traffic, ACC shall keep controlling the vehicle down to 5 m/s.
texts.ACC-R-048: The system shall work reliably in all weather conditions.
texts.ACC-R-049: After a sensor fault, the system shall recover within a reasonable time.
texts.ACC-R-050: The driver shall be able to switch ACC off with one button press.
